truths.truth: Every store writes through one fsynced temp-and-rename helper under its own lock: concurrent writers both land, a write killed before the rename leaves the previous file whole, connection.json stays 0600
truths.evidence: Helper hqptuner/atomicwrite.py:35-56 (O_EXCL random temp, fsync, replace, dir fsync off win32; temp unlinked on BaseException). Adopted at every write site: live.py:269, favorites.py:180, descriptions.py:299, autopilot.py:144, narrowing.py:317, matrixmode.py:180, presets.py:226,275,312,341, filterpark.py:174, presetops.py:152, core/connection.py:134 (mode=0o600); grep of hqptuner for write_text/write_bytes/open('w')/os.replace finds only desktop.py devnull and core/login.py (scoped out). Locks: threading.Lock per instance in all 6 JSON stores, PresetStore (presets.py:179, held in save/delete/set_autosave/set_active), FilterPark (filterpark.py:152), PresetOps._backup_lock (presetops.py:191), ConnectionStore (connection.py:90); read-modify-write inside the hold (e.g. live.py:289-295, narrowing.py:311-317). Tests pass: tests/test_atomic_write.py (10), tests/presets/integrity/test_atomic_writes.py (14, killed-write cases per store), tests/presets/integrity/test_store_locks.py (7, forced-overlap writers on 5 JSON stores, PresetStore, FilterPark), tests/api/login/test_connection_file_mode.py asserts 0o600. Note, not a gap: the leftover-temp case there plants 'connection.json.tmp', a name the helper no longer uses; the O_EXCL random name covers the hazard. NarrowingStore, PresetOps and ConnectionStore locks have no behavioral test (whole-document writes, last-wins either way), recorded in DISPOSITIONS F-031.
